pages.title: The Fish Forecast
pages.text: Obtain a Pocket Watch, Climate Gauge, Depth Meter and Weather Radio.

pages.title: The Fish Forecast
pages.text: Prepare to seek special fishing conditions.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Each instrument explains a different condition. JEI lists their recipes; they need not be obtained at the same moment.

pages.title: Choose a fishing habitat
pages.text: Compare the dimension, fluid, depth, climate, time, weather, moon and season with the fish's entry. Catch selection depends on context rather than one universal pool.

pages.title: Read fishing conditions
pages.text: The watch shows time, Lunar Calendar shows moon phase, Depth Meter shows depth, Weather Radio forecasts weather and Fish Finder shows fishing context. Climate Gauge reports biome temperature without weather or seasonal adjustments.

pages.title: Collect fish in a satchel
pages.text: Open the Fish Satchel with right-click to make it collect catches automatically. A closed satchel in inventory is not active collection.
